# Collection notes

Correction recorded 2026-09-25: the selected 2007 binary release 1/071226 actually reports version 1.1 (event suveh-nux-0a645cbebf:e00002), while the guide describes version 1.0. Full compatibility is unproven; do not conflate either with the later 2015 file. The earlier note incorrectly implied a version match. Startup is [Press a key]; use a single space then observe. Spell vocabulary and word order are part of the puzzle; a different spell effect is not an intent-preserving wording fix. Seek an actual escape ending, not only a percentage or learned spell.

Collect varied synthetic command mistakes with explicit intent and actual failed/recovery responses. All labels start unreviewed. Ask for small walkthrough excerpts only as needed. Never read the full guide outside the broker or publish/train on this material. Preserve checkpoints and evidence.

"Yes, master?"

You rush to your master's side and await his instructions. He is studying a 
fragile looking scroll and muttering to himself.

He looks up and says, "Ah, there you are. This ..." -- he hands you the scroll 
-- " ... goes back in the vault. I believe it is still open. And this little 
beastie ..." -- he hands you a small, empty brass cage -- "... goes back to my 
private quarters. Thank you, that will be all."

and a golden key juts out of the lock.

Without warning, someone shoves you roughly from behind. The scroll and the 
brass cage fly out of your hands as you fall to the ground. There is a loud 
"click", and everything turns black.
